name: dragon-agents
description: Research subagents for repo, markets, and machine work: repo maps, doc-drift and release audits, cascade and spec checks, CI triage and posture, workspace sweeps, code review, git archaeology, claim verification, dependency and test-gap audits, debt census, duplication scouting, slop reads, equity and ETF research briefs from keyless public market data, personal finance, book-library, and music-collection briefs, dataset profiling, security review, machine and backup health census, charter design for new agents, the Calibre acquisition pipeline's gated execution seat (import phases 1 and 2) with its read-only phase auditor, five audit-and-fix seats whose writes ride the charter-fence model (apply mode, clean tree, named scope, never a commit), a purpose-built web-research report writer (one new cited file per dispatch, keyless sources, never an edit), a two-mode grader (five-metric repo report cards with an append-only, zero-deletion roadmap goals block; read-only idea grading with web prior art), and a GitHub-metadata seat that tends repo descriptions and topics through gh (propose by default, two mutation verbs only, every write read back).
